item.title: Cabrillo football coach Justin Hansen to take leave of absence
item.description: Cabrillo College announced Monday that head football coach Justin Hansen will take a formal family medical leave of absence effective immediately. Hansen is expected to be away from his coaching duties through the end of the spring semester, with the possibility of extending into the fall. An interim head coach has not been named yet. […]
